issues.description: The problem statement / UML specifies that the Lecture constructor should initialize attributes in the order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implements a constructor with parameters in a different order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This discrepancy in constructor parameter order is structural and can confuse students who follow the UML or tests that expect the UML order, causing constructor-call mismatches or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML/problem statement: change the constructor signature in the solution (and template) to public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly — or alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to document the constructor parameter order used in the code. Ensure tests and examples use the same order.
